title: VISITS TO RASHTRAPATI BHAVAN, RASHTRAPATI BHAVAN MUSEUM AND AMRIT UDYAN TO REMAIN CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC FROM SEPTEMBER 11 TO 13
body_text:
Visits to Rashtrapati Bhavan, Rashtrapati Bhavan Museum and Amrit Udyan will remain closed to the public from September 11 to 13, 2026. The Change of Guard Ceremony will also not take place at the Forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan on this Saturday (September 12, 2026).
*****
